metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: DURA correction with source same-record contrastive auxiliary representation
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory seven-view Phase1 test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Correction initialization 2026110612; source fit ID selection 2026110611; training order 2026110613; evaluation 2026092701
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 physical records x seven views batch8; independent truth-last

notes: Frozen DURA plus multiscale correction; source auxiliary encoder updates on symmetric multi-positive record contrast at temperature 0.1, then frozen for correction update with weight 0.05.

Record IDs derive only from known source view-major row alignment: all occurrences of the same physical source record are positives; different records may belong to the same TX and are not asserted to be different devices.
Clean IQ and three fixed source observations are used only for source training; auxiliary encoder, record IDs, clean IQ, F and TX are never inference inputs.
Fit 32768 permitted source IDs with three simulated views and fixed five epochs; no F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target reads.
Source-only instance matching may capture packet content or receiver effects; it is not an identity guarantee.
Frozen candidate must complete 168000 x seven Phase1 Main split views with fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and independent truth-last scoring.

Motivation: Chen et al., Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Robust RF Device Fingerprinting Under Time-Domain Shift, https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.04036 ; this restoration method is not a reproduction and must be evaluated independently.
